candidate.title: MARS-Seq
candidate.scope: The single-route Illumina schematic titled Massively parallel RNA single-cell sequencing framework (MARS-Seq), matched to Jaitin et al. (PMID 24531970). It depicts tagged poly(A)-RNA preparation through an amplified RNA intermediate to a P5/P7-bearing cDNA library. First-strand reverse transcription, pooled preparation and the omitted in vitro transcription interface are explicitly distinguished as text-supported clarifications. Similar-method lists, associated kits, application studies and unshown adaptations are not additional target methods. No separate assay branch or alternative is depicted.

states.label: Polyadenylated single-cell mRNA
features: The initial icon is one representative poly(A)-tailed RNA; the yellow surround has no legend and is not assigned an attachment chemistry.
Single-cell origin is established upstream in individual wells by the text; FACS and lysis are context, not separate depicted operations.
Biological target: sampled mRNA expression in individual cells, rather than every cellular RNA species.

evidence.locator: Leftmost RNA icon: purple strand, yellow surround and AA(A)n tail
Description, first occurrence (source text line 3)
evidence.quote: The mRNA is reverse-transcribed to generate the first cDNA strand and treated with exonuclease I to remove leftover RT primers. Next, the cellular lysates are pooled together and converted to double-stranded cDNA. The DNA strands are transcribed to RNA and treated with DNase to remove leftover DNA templates in the mixture. The RNA strands are fragmented and annealed to sequencing adapters, followed by RT to generate barcoded cDNA libraries that are ready for sequencing.

evidence.locator: [b00006]-[b00007], MARS-Seq introduction and three levels of barcoding
evidence.quote: We developed an automated massively parallel RNA single-cell sequencing framework (MARS-Seq, figures S1 to S6 and Supplementary methods (21)) that is designed for in vivo sampling of thousands of cells by multiplexing RNA sequencing while maintaining tight control over amplification biases and labeling errors. The method is based on FACS sorting of single cells into 384-well plates and subsequent automated processing that is done mostly on pooled and labeled material, leading to a dramatic increase in throughput and reproducibility.

states.label: Amplified, purified P5/P7-bearing cDNA sequencing library
features: Final icon is labelled cDNA and bears P5 and P7 at opposite ends, with insert and internal coloured segments retained.
Sequenced carrier is DNA derived through an amplified RNA intermediate; the biological quantities of interest are sampled original mRNAs by cell.
UMIs support molecule counting rather than equating PCR reads with independently captured transcripts; cellular and plate tags support multiplexed origin assignment.
The intended readout is gene expression from sampled transcript ends; full-length isoforms, complete capture of all RNAs, and exact read/index allocation are not established by this drawing.
